summary: All corrected-hook PLT 8192-node batch1024 one-token traces completed on Cardinal within 40 minutes. Increasing feature/logit/attribution batch size from 64 to 1024 converted the previous batch64 walltime blocker into feasible runtimes, even with conservative decoder cache disabled and chunked_feature_replay_window=4.

interpretation.batch1024_result: Feasible for one-token 8192-node corrected-hook PLT width_262k runs on H100/Cardinal under 400G and 2h walltime.
interpretation.speed_vs_batch64: Batch64 telemetry projected multi-hour PLT Phase-4 runtimes; batch1024 completed all variants in 15-40 minutes total elapsed.
interpretation.remaining_optimization_note: Runs still used decoder_cache_bytes=0, decoder_chunk_size=2048, and replay_window=4, so the planned confirmation stage should test memory-for-speed knobs rather than treating this as fully optimized.
